title: 第5章 我这是穿到哪里了第6章 仙门
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
只是脑袋转到里面好像没用，还是能看到后面的景物。
卧槽，老天，你给我这超能力，好像是偷窥专用！
看到晴儿龇牙咧嘴的样子，黄夜也是紧握拳头，心头升起一丝莫名的怒火。
嘿嘿，二少爷是吧，我已经记住你了，既然你对我这个弟弟不仁，也别怪我不义，此仇不报非君子。
“吱扭！”一声，月儿捧着衣服进来。
衣服上放着一个小盒，黄夜把头埋进被子，他怕受不了。
换衣的画面太辣眼睛，很容易喷一床鼻血。
片刻之后，耳边响起“嘶啊！嘶啊……”的声音。
听得黄夜小心脏直跳。
“姐姐，他们真下得去手。”
“呵呵，这已经不错了，吴管家求情，我才挨了五下。”
“这五下也够狠的，小屁屁都快抽烂了。”
两人忙活好一会儿，晴儿才被扶到床上。
“姐姐，你好好在床上趴两天，我照顾你们俩。”
“谢谢妹妹了！”
“姐姐客气了，我把被子给你们盖好。”
温软的娇躯靠在黄夜身上。
月儿收拾一下便出去了。
黄夜的脑袋也从被窝里钻出来。
转过头，看着趴着的晴儿，心底不由地一颤。

下意识的问了一句，“很疼吧？”
晴儿猛地睁开眼睛，愣愣地看着黄夜。
“啊！”的一声惊叫，小嘴张的大大，脸上全是迷惑和不解。
“少爷，刚才是你在说话么？”晴儿声音颤颤的问道。
她已经看到黄夜清澈的眼睛，再无一丝迷茫之色。
“嗯，我说很疼吧！”
一只小手伸出来，摸到黄夜脸上，使劲掐了掐！
卧槽，应该是掐自己才对吧，黄夜皱了皱眉头！
“少爷，我不是做梦吧，您真的醒了。”
黄夜笑了笑，轻轻点了点头。
哗哗！小丫头的泪水犹如滔滔江水连绵不绝掉下来。
晴儿没有看他，直接把头埋进枕头。
“呜呜呜！”的哭起来，双肩不停地抖动。
黄夜伸出手，想拍拍她的后背，悬在空中，迟迟未落下。
最后还是落下，轻轻拍着晴儿的后背。
“好了，不哭了，我清醒过来，一切都会好的，放心，我不会让你白挨打。”
“呜呜呜……！”晴儿继续抽噎了一会儿，这才转过头看向黄夜。
“少爷，奴婢这打挨得值，挨得太值了！”
“您不用替我申冤，这是我自愿的，如果不挨打，您可能还不会清醒。”
“奴婢现在高兴还来不及呢。”

说完，布满泪水的小脸已是笑颜绽放。
“好了，你先好好休息。”
content_en:
It seems useless to turn your head inside, but you can still see the scenery behind.
Damn it, God, you gave me this super power, it seems to be just for peeping!
Seeing Qing'er's grinning look, Huang Ye also clenched his fists, feeling an inexplicable anger rising in his heart.
Hehe, second young master, right? I have already remembered you. Since you are unkind to my younger brother, don't blame me for being unjust. It would be unkind to not avenge this.
"Squeak!" With a sound, Yue'er came in holding clothes.
There was a small box on the clothes. Huang Ye buried his head in the quilt, he was afraid that he wouldn't be able to bear it.
The scene of changing clothes is so eye-catching that it can easily lead to nosebleeds.
After a while, a sound of "His! Hiss..." sounded in my ears.
Huang Yexiao's heart beat rapidly when he heard it.
"Sister, they are really cruel."
"Haha, that's not bad. Butler Wu begged for mercy, and I only got five blows."
"These five swats are so hard that my little butt is almost bruised."
The two of them worked for a while before Qing'er was helped to the bed.
"Sister, you stay on the bed for two days and I will take care of you both."
"Thank you sister!"
"Sister, you're welcome. I'll cover you with the quilt."
Her soft and delicate body leaned against Huang Ye.
Yue'er tidied up and went out.
Huang Ye's head also emerged from the bed.
Turning his head and looking at Qing'er lying on his stomach, he couldn't help but tremble in his heart.
I subconsciously asked, "Does it hurt?"
Qing'er opened her eyes suddenly and looked at Huang Ye blankly.
"Ah!" exclaimed, the little mouth opened wide, and the face was full of confusion and confusion.
"Master, was it you who spoke just now?" Qing'er asked with a trembling voice.
She had seen Huang Ye's clear eyes, and there was no trace of confusion anymore.
"Well, I said it hurts!"
A small hand stretched out, touched Huang Ye's face, and pinched it hard!
Damn it, you should be pinching yourself, Huang Ye frowned!
"Master, I am not dreaming, you are really awake."
Huang Ye smiled and nodded lightly.
Wow! The little girl's tears fell continuously like a torrent of river water.
Qing'er didn't look at him and buried her head in the pillow.
"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu" I cried, my shoulders shaking constantly.
Huang Ye stretched out his hand, wanting to pat her back, but it hung in the air and did not fall down.
Finally, he fell down and patted Qing'er's back gently.
"Okay, stop crying. I'll wake up and everything will be fine. Don't worry, I won't let your beating be in vain."
"Woooooo...!" Qing'er continued to sob for a while, then turned her head to look at Huang Ye.
"Master, this slave's beating is worth it, it's worth it!"
"You don't have to plead my grievance. This is of my own free will. If you don't get beaten, you may not wake up."
"It's too late for my slave to be happy now."
After saying that, the little face covered with tears was already smiling.
"Okay, you have a good rest first."
